title: Meet the main characters
summary: You play as two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Rockstar has published short bios of them and the people around them. Open the details for that background.

details.summary: Background from Rockstar's official character bios, in brief.
steps: Jason Duval grew up around con artists, did a stint in the Army, and now does work for drug runners in the Keys.
Lucia Caminos was taught to fight by her father. Fighting for her family landed her in Leonida Penitentiary; she's just out and has a plan.
Cal Hampton: Jason's friend, a homebody who listens in on Coast Guard radio and believes every conspiracy online.
Brian Heder: a veteran smuggler in the Keys who lets Jason live in one of his properties in return for help with local jobs.
Boobie Ike: a Vice City figure who turned street money into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio, and co-runs Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest.
Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy): a rap duo signed to Only Raw Records, chasing a second hit.
Raul Bautista: an experienced bank robber who recruits people willing to take big risks.

title: GTA+ perks: sell vehicles for more, pay less in shops
summary: If you have a GTA+ membership on console, Rockstar lists optional perks in the story: 10% more money when you sell a vehicle you own, 10% off at many shops, and free or upgraded ways to get around. Skip this if you don't subscribe; nothing in the game requires it.
steps: GTA+ is a paid monthly membership bought through the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store. It renews automatically until you cancel.
Keep the membership active and play online to claim the perks.
Sell vehicles you own rather than abandoning them: members get a 10% higher sale price.
Buy weapons, clothes, haircuts, tattoos and vehicle mods at participating shops to get the 10% discount.

title: What counts toward 100% completion
summary: You don't have to collect everything. Finishing the story is half of the total, and the rest comes from a spread of crime, exploration and activity targets.
steps: Main story: 50%. All optional missions: 6%.
Crime work (illegal operations, bank and payday-loan jobs, smash-and-grabs, stick-ups, vaults and fencing goods) makes up most of the rest, a few percent each.
Exploration, activities and discoveries are 1% each, e.g. 15 of the 18 card sets, 90 basketball hoops, 300 stunts, 200 vehicles found.
You can only see your 100% tracker in-game after the story: Map → Progress → Stats.

title: McKittrick Farm (Chapter 2)
summary: A four-part optional mission for Kyle, a farmer with a busted arm who needs a pilot. Parts 1 and 2 pay $1,400 in total; how it ends is behind the spoiler reveal.
steps: Start: once you control Lucia in Chapter 2 (after What's In the Bag begins), look at the "pilot wanted" flyer beside the Starlet Motel office door before you see Linda. Inspecting it marks McKittrick Farm on your map, about a mile away, east of Port Gellhorn.

Part 1, crop dusting: meet Kyle at the grass airstrip and take his plane up. Fly over the pink marker when he calls for it and hold R1 / RB to spray. Do it three times, then land back on the grass strip (approach wide and cut the power). Pays $400.

Part 2, chemicals: Kyle texts later asking for chemicals from the Farm Fix Meth Lab, the Final Chapter gang's illegal operation in Leonard County, north of Belville. Talk your way past the gate guard instead of fighting.

Free van: when the gang asks for money, choose Negotiate → Pay Later → offer collateral (Kyle's plane). Paying instead ($3,000 via Negotiate → Pay Less, or $5,000 outright) makes no difference later, so take it free. Stealing it by force is also possible but means fighting the gang.
Drive the van to Kyle's barn (marked) for $1,000. The giant strawberries are safe to eat and give you a short buff.
Parts 3 and 4 start by themselves later in Chapter 2 with texts from Kyle. Open the spoiler details for what happens.

details.summary: Kyle's strawberries are mutating him. In part 3 he has turned into a huge, rampaging creature; in part 4 you track him to the meth lab, where he leaps away for good. Completing it earns the Western Searing Zombie Bobber, a standout motorcycle.
steps: Part 3: after Kyle's increasingly garbled texts (the last one reads like "I hurt"), go back to the farm. It's surrounded by police. Offer to help, say you're Kyle's friend and that you feel fine, then put on the hazmat suit from the ambulance.

In the barn Kyle has mutated. He wrecks the police and their cars, so keep your distance until he calms down, then talk to him and tell him to leave. He asks for a hug (it costs a little health) and leaps off. Drop any gun and leave before more police arrive.

Part 4: no text tells you, but Kyle has gone back to the Farm Fix Meth Lab. The gate is smashed and the gang is in chaos. Use Focus Mode to spot him in the big building on the left, go up the stairs and talk to him. He jumps out through a skylight and the mission is complete (no on-screen notice).

With the gang scattered you can loot the warehouse unopposed: the safe in the upstairs office (its code is on a note in the side lab), the Throttler Verro weapon variant on the walkway, and the Western Searing Zombie Bobber standout motorcycle at the foot of the stairs.

title: Vanessa's pink Pfister Growler: the laptop password (Muffins, Queen, 15)
summary: The laptop in your Chapter 3 safehouse belonged to the last tenant, Vanessa. Crack its password and it leads you to a hidden garage in La Perle with a free pink Pfister Growler sports car and the garage itself.
steps: In the apartment, look at the photo on the hallway side table: that gives you the word "Muffins".
Look at the notepad on the bedroom vanity, then flip it over: the drawing gives "Queen" and the back gives "15".

On the laptop, choose Muffins, Queen, 15. Open Vanessa's WhatUp messages: one from "Unknown" mentions a gift in La Perle next to Auntie's Place, with the code 92665. (Triangle/Y translates her messages with her mom.)

Auntie's Place isn't on the map. Go to Aline's Thrift Store in La Perle, cross the run-down motel car park next to it, and find the closed Auntie's Place. The garage just past it has a bow drawn by the door.
Enter 92665 on the keypad. It only works after you've read the message on the laptop.
Drive the Growler out to register it for free. You also get the Del Rio Boulevard Garage.
